messages:
Maya Chen: quick thing — I pushed a prototype to the release-bot for a 'latch/unwind' flow. Goal: give an operator-safe way to temporarily 'latch' a rollout, capture preflight state, and then 'unwind' with a guarded rollback that runs sanity checks first. sketch below.

release-bot: new commands available in #eng-releases (beta):
- /latch <release-id> --desc \"reason\" --ttl <mins>  (creates lock + preflight snapshot)
- /unwind <release-id> --confirm --mode [graceful|force|dry-run] (attempts safe rollback)
- /latch-status <release-id> (shows lock owner, expires_at, snapshot link)

Samir Patel: nice. quick q: what does the snapshot capture? metrics? routing?

Maya Chen: good call. snapshot =
```
service_routes: list
healthy_instances: count + hostnames
env_config_hash
last_deploy_commit
canary_traffic_pct
latency_p50/p95/p99
recent_error_rate
```
It also stores a small preflight checklist (see template). stored on s3 with a signed url (ttl matches lock).

Liam O'Connor: add a `--dry-run` for unwind so we can preview steps without executing. also make `--mode=graceful` try incremental traffic shift back to previous version with safety gates.

Anya Gomez: can the latch include a link to the release notes/changelog? We should enforce a changelog url for any latch created in a change window. saves us chasing context.

Maya Chen: yup — latch requires `--changelog-url` in prod windows (throw validation otherwise). Also planning a small template that autopopulates into the RIT page when latch is created.

Samir Patel: edge cases: what if the previous version isn't available? unwind should fallback to a pinned artifact or pause and notify SRE. don't auto-unwind to an unknown image.

Maya Chen: agreed. unwind will: 1) check pinned artifacts for target release 2) run health checks against a staging slice 3) only then flip. fallback path = pause + @eng-oncall notify + link to manual rollback playbook.

release-bot: example preflight checklist created at https://s3.example.com/preflight/2084123456.json (ttl 2h)

Maya Chen: prototype preflight template (short):
```
- deploy_id: 2084123456
- owner: @maya
- changelog: <url>
- must_pass_checks: [smoke, auth, db-migrations]
- rollback_plan: "unwind to release 2084020000 or contact oncall"
- monitoring_panels: [latency, error-rate, infra-cpu]
```
make these fields fillable from `./release create --template preflight` too.

Liam O'Connor: also add a `--hold-until` flag so latch can auto-expire at end of change window instead of manual unwind.

Anya Gomez: +1 on auto-expire. also request audit log entry for every latch/unwind action (who, why, diff of snapshot). compliance will love that.

Maya Chen: action items: 1) add dry-run + mode to unwind (Samir/Liam) 2) require changelog-url for latches during change windows (Maya/Anya) 3) store snapshot + audit logs in signed s3 bucket (Maya) 4) add auto-expire `--hold-until` (Liam) 5) docs + snippet for oncall playbook (Anya). I'll sketch a PR for the bot this afternoon. :thumbsup:

Samir Patel: I can review the PR, will test against canary cluster.

Liam O'Connor: I'll wire the incremental traffic shift logic into the rollout controller and expose a `--rate-step` param.

Anya Gomez: I'll start a short doc in the runbook repo and add the audit/mitigation checklist.

Maya Chen: thanks all — aiming to run a dogfood deploy with latch enabled next Tue during the morning window. will ping here when scheduled.
